answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, preventing a fable of infinite identities by requiring economic capital for influence. Each validator thread must lock native tokens to participate in consensus, effectively pricing out adversaries. The cost of an attack equals the value of a falcon strike against the network’s total security budget; an attacker faces total capital forfeiture if they attempt to compromise the state, ensuring that honesty is the only profitable strategy.
